The orphan-identity, horizon-substitution, and composite-channel mutations each failed at their intended guard; the deliberate post-launch-failure court exited nonzero and the final browser audit found no owned browser processes left alive.

One preservation disclosure: the first intentional orphan-failure run regenerated the pre-existing untracked generated artifact `app/smoke/diagnostics/live-shell-failure.png`. No mockup files were touched, and no generated diagnostic was staged.

The shipped contract is the bounded one reviewed here: direct, via-ancestor proxy, and off-projection states remain distinct across Atlas and Codex; proxy treatment is non-colour and does not claim that the ancestor is the selected identity.
